KOGI STATE (PSI 7.0): Kogi Pension Commission Issues Rejoinder to SAN; Details ₦278m Judicial Gratuity Payments
KADUNA STATE (PSI 7.0): Kaduna Govt Dismisses N2.3 Trillion Campaign Claim as Fabricated Disinformation
TARABA (PSI 9.3): Signed a strategic MoU with XCMG in China for electric mining equipment supply, local assembly hubs, technical training, and road network financing.
JIGAWA (PSI 9.0): Signed a $10m Joint Venture deal with India's Srinivasa Farms (40% state equity) to build Northern Nigeria's first modern hatchery in Dutse.
GOMBE (PSI 8.8): Unanimously passed State Police Bill. Gov Yahaya met President Tinubu in Abuja, while state acquired modern surveying tools and partnered with CHAI.
KATSINA (PSI 8.7): Commissioned 120MVA Kankia power transmission substation with Power Minister. Community hunters in Bakori repelled bandit attack, killing 14.
BAYELSA (PSI 8.6): Defended N46bn electronic secretariat and 108 housing units at Okaka. Confirmed 21km Nembe-Brass road is 85% complete.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.5): Paraded arms suspects intercepted by DSS along Bekwarra-Ogoja axis. Signed 25-year PPP fishery concession with Eburutu Fishery and trained pension officers.
DELTA (PSI 8.4): Approved ₦4bn to empower 15,000 indigent residents across 25 LGAs, appointed Dr. Charity Ehimen Head of Service, and intensified Ebola checks.
ABIA (PSI 8.3): Announced hosting AfrICANDO 2026 U.S.–Africa Trade Conference in Umuahia on Nov 17–19 under AfCFTA. Gov Otti attended Rhema University convocation.
LAGOS (PSI 8.2): LASWARCO held water tariff guidelines workshop, MCCTI announced digital monitoring for Ease of Doing Business at LPPS 2026, and hosted Olokun Festival.
BORNO (PSI 8.1): Pledged stronger AU partnership to enroll 800,000 out-of-school children, receiving AU Special Envoy Ambassador Jainaba Jagne in Maiduguri.
IMO (PSI 8.0): Completed Orlu–Mgbe–Akokwa–Uga Road with Umuchima erosion control. ISOPADEC MD monitored staff promotion exercise.
PLATEAU (PSI 7.9): 10th Assembly adopted State Police Bill. Rolled out Free Mega Medical Outreach across senatorial districts and conducted SURWASH training in Langtang North.
RIVERS (PSI 7.8): Inspected Creek Road Market reconstruction, confirming 700 stalls in phase one will be delivered by January 2027 to restore urban trade order.
OSUN (PSI 7.7): Approved Ebola prevention plan, appointed Onijabe of Ijabeland and 5 other rulers, and confirmed Dr. Raheem remains Provost of Ilesa Health College.
FCT ABUJA (PSI 7.6): Approved construction of Kuje-Sabo-Yenche-Rubochi Road and confirmed phase two of Kuje-Gwagwalada road will be completed by December 2026.
EDO (PSI 7.5): Resolved Ojirami community mining CDA dispute. Akoko-Edo LGA Chairman pledged operational vehicles for Special Constabulary Police.
OGUN (PSI 7.4): Gov. Abiodun attended Odofin installation in Remoland. Completed asphalt laying on 535m stretch of Okenla Road in Ijebu-Ode.
KANO (PSI 7.3): Approved immediate MRTF allowance payment to 90 doctors and initiated administrative alignment with federal medical salary structures.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.2): Appointed Kabiru Jelani Statistician-General, redeployed 19 Perm Secs, and partnered with UNICEF on World Polio Day walk in Gusau.
BENUE (PSI 7.1): Reassured residents of active negotiations with JED to restore power supply while directing security agencies to investigate disconnection disputes.
KOGI (PSI 7.0): Issued official rejoinder detailing ₦278.07m paid to 15 retired judicial officers in 2026, demanding 24-hour retraction of derogatory remarks.
KADUNA (PSI 7.0): Dismissed fabricated letter claiming N2.3 trillion presidential campaign expenditure, pointing out that state's total annual budget is N985.92bn.
ADAMAWA (PSI 3.0): Relaxed Lamurde curfew to 9pm-6am following calm, while Works Ministry inspected ongoing construction on the 18km Girei-Pariya road.
